<!--
Looking for a new integration (calendar, photo source, web service, theme)?
That usually belongs in a plugin, and plugins live in their own repository:
https://github.com/osterbergsimon/calvin-plugins
Open the request there if the change would not need anything from the Calvin
core. If you are unsure, file it here.
-->

## Feature description

A clear and concise description of the feature you would like to see.

## Problem statement

What problem does this solve? What are you trying to do today, and where does
Calvin get in the way? Real use cases help us judge the shape of the solution.

## Proposed solution

How you imagine it working — a setting, a new screen, an API endpoint, a
plugin hook. Rough is fine; sketch or mockup welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways to solve the same problem, including what you do today (another
tool, a workaround, a custom plugin).

## Who it is for

- **Deployment:** all-in-one Pi / remote backend + kiosk Pi / Unraid / dev
- **Hardware (if it matters):** Pi model, display size and orientation
- **Who interacts with it:** admin in Settings, someone at the kiosk, both

## Additional context

Links, screenshots, API docs of the service involved, or examples from other
dashboards.

## Implementation notes (optional)

If you have looked at the code and have ideas — relevant files, the plugin
contract (`docs/plugins/PLUGIN_INTERFACE.md`), or whether this should be a
first-party feature or a plugin — share them here.
